results.title: Discover as the old reader's: notes first, Create a note
results.checks: On Obadiah 1 with no notes, Discover opens with '+ Create' and Notes first, chips across the top (All, then one per source), every source one line with its count under All; tapping one shows it alone with its chip on, All goes back — 'You don't have any notes for this chapter. Create a note'; Create a note opens the note editor for verse 1; + Create offers Note and Playlist; the sources follow (no source that has nothing)
results.note: Discover: chips All · References · Places · Content · People & events · Writings; Cross-references 40 chevron_right shown alone and All back; Create a note opened the editor; + Create offers Note and Playlist
